campaigns.desc:
<BODY style="FONT-SIZE: xx-small; FONT-FAMILY: Segoe UI; FONT-WEIGHT: normal"><P align=left></P>
<P><FONT size=3>As the South China Sea increasingly becomes a theater of great power competition, the regional powers look for a way to safeguard their independence and prosperity. Started as a trade bloc, the Association of South-East Asian Nations (ASEAN) responded to increased military activity and Chinese provocation with increased military cooperation, culminating in the now annual ASEAN Solidarity Exercise in 2023 (ASEX-23). The year is now 2025, following the success of ASEX-23 and 24 and foreign influence in the ongoing Myanmar civil war, the new ASEAN chair, Malaysia, hopes to make a statement about Chinese designs on the region. ASEX-25 will feature land exercises on the Malay peninsula and naval and air exercises north of China’s 10-Dash Line, a direct and clear indicator to Beijing of the bloc's growing discontent with the PRC’s activities. In Beijing, a unified, militarized, and uncooperative ASEAN poses an existential threat to the Chinese Communist Party's ambitions. The Central Military Commission of the PRC has directed its "Little Blue Men" in the Maritime Militia (PAFMM) to harass and disrupt the exercise with support from the Chinese Coast Guard. </P></FONT></BODY>
scenarios: One Vision, One Identity, One Community

<BODY scroll=auto><B>Date:</B> 29 November 1985 <BR><B>Location:</B> GIUK Gap <BR><B>Playable Side:</B> NATO <BR><B>Duration:</B> 2 days <BR>
<P>Following an incident at sea between a US destroyer and a Soviet spy ship, the world teeters on the brink of World War Three. As the Soviet Red Banner North Fleet sorties from its bases in the Barents Sea, NATO submarines in the east Atlantic scramble to intercept the Red submarines before they can break out into the western Atlantic.</P></BODY>

scens.desc:
<BODY scroll=auto><B>Date:</B> 6 December 1985 <BR><B>Location:</B> North Atlantic <BR><B>Playable Side:</B> Soviet Union <BR><B>Duration:</B> 1 day <BR>
<P>World War III has been raging for a full week, and as yet neither side has secured a firm advantage. The Soviet Union has made rapid gains in Europe, but the Red Army is suffering heavily from NATO air attack. On the Naval front, NATO has managed to contain the Red Banner North Fleet within the Norwegian Sea and yesterday conducted a massive carrier-borne air offensive against the Soviet Union with heavy losses on both sides.</P></BODY>
